name: blunt-cake
title_zh: 代码贴上来就开喷，专治自我感觉良好
tagline_zh: 别找温柔陪练了。你贴代码它开喷，从命名到架构逐刀砍，喷完还告诉你哪刀该躲、哪刀该挨。
tagline_en: Skip the gentle coach. Paste code, get carved up—naming, architecture, all of it—then told which cuts to dodge.
desc_en: Use this skill whenever a user pastes, attaches, or points at code and asks for opinionated critique — especially brutal, savage, funny, harsh, honest, or merciless feedback. Strong triggers: "review this," "what's wrong with," "tell me everything wrong," "brutal/savage feedback," "roast," "judge," "audit," "grade," "rip apart," "don't hold back," "is this bad," "embarrassing," profanity about the
why_zh: 不是泛泛说'不错但可改进'。它按代码的羞耻度分级开火，每句批评都钉在具体行号上，让你笑着疼完。
why_en: No vague 'nice but improvable.' It calibrates firepower to how cringe the code is, pins every jab to a line number, and makes.
limit_zh: 只对贴出来的代码负责，不读仓库上下文、不懂业务意图。它喷的是'这段代码本身'，不是'你为什么这么写'。
limit_en: Judges only the pasted snippet—no repo context, no business intent. It roasts the code as-is, not your reasoning. No refactoring plans or.
